detail.summary: The first boundary of the innings comes off a ball in the slot.
detail.quote: Always helps when you have played at that level and that's the first boundary of the inning.

detail.summary: A direct hit from the field leads to a likely run-out, possibly the first wicket.
detail.quote: Bowling, and that's us! Direct hit!

detail.summary: A run-out after a direct hit is sent upstairs to the third umpire.
detail.quote: Our review for runout at the Bolaal friend. Can you give me your first angle please?

detail.summary: A direct hit may have caused a run out, the first wicket, but the third umpire hasn't confirmed it yet.
detail.quote: And that could be the first wicket down there.

detail.summary: Run out after sharp fielding; Triumph Knights lose their first wicket.
detail.quote: Quick silver work in the field and that's the first wicket down for prime knights.

detail.summary: Sidhaant is run out by a direct pick-up-and-throw from Sairaj Patil.
detail.quote: I think Sidhaant was batting well, but unfortunately we run out.

detail.summary: A Triumph Knights batter is praised for a half-century, though the call is unclear.
detail.quote: Fabulous half century.

detail.summary: Jigar Rana reaches a milestone with a single, celebrated by the Triumph Knights dugout.
detail.quote: He'll get there with another single as the Triumph Knights, those boys sitting in the...

detail.summary: Jigar is caught, giving Eagle Thane Strikers the breakthrough.
detail.quote: Kulkarni. His input should be vital for the side. Thane Strikers, this is gone.

detail.summary: Jigar is out, caught straight to a fielder, giving the bowling side the breakthrough.
detail.quote: Straight to hand and that's the wicket they were looking for. That's the breakthrough. Jigar gone.

detail.summary: Suryakumar Yadav starts his innings with a boundary straight away.
detail.quote: 950s vs Suryakumar Yadav. Mr. 360 they call him and starts off with the boundary straight away.

detail.summary: A review is taken for a run out at the striker's end after a direct hit.
detail.quote: We have a review for a runout at the strikers end.

detail.summary: The third umpire gives Parikshit run out.
detail.quote: And the third umpire's decision. There comes, that's the end and that's very unfortunate.

detail.summary: Parikshit is run out by a direct hit while going for a quick single.
detail.quote: He is batting well. Parikshit unfortunately run out there.

detail.summary: A direct hit causes a run out while the batters try to complete a single, though this may be a replay.
detail.quote: You can see this, trying to seal that single and a direct hit, resulting in the run out.

detail.summary: After a strong appeal involving Ankolekar, the decision goes to DRS.
detail.quote: And as for the DRS, front on coming.

detail.summary: Suryakumar Yadav gets four runs over square after a misfield.
detail.quote: 3-0, 4 runs and Amit would be livid with that feeling effort.

detail.summary: Suryakumar Yadav edges behind and the catch carries to the keeper, Tanna.
detail.quote: 29 of those have come from Suryakumar Yadav. That's got to be out. That's a nice thick edge.

detail.summary: The keeper's brilliant take leads to another run out.
detail.quote: Brilliantly taken by the keeper. Also going to result in another runout.

detail.summary: Another easy run out after a sharp effort from the wicketkeeper.
detail.quote: Impressive. And one more easy run out. How many run outs have you...

detail.summary: Jigar is praised for what may be his fifty.
detail.quote: Jigar Rana was extremely good, impressive with his 50th

detail.summary: The first ball of the innings is about to be bowled.
detail.quote: Starting the first ball coming up.

detail.summary: Garbled commentary may describe a wicket falling after a lofted shot under pressure.
detail.quote: I'm in the middle of losing a wicket in doing so.

detail.summary: A batter edges one and appears to be out, which makes things worse for the batting side.
detail.quote: Power play, they were going pretty much neck and neck and that is an edge.

detail.summary: The batter holds out into the deep on the off side and J Jain takes the catch, after Triumph Knights stuck to a wide-line plan under Suryakumar Yadav.
detail.quote: And holds out into the deep on the offside.

detail.summary: A fielder running backwards takes a catch in the deep, just holding on.
detail.quote: In North-the-distance and hanging on it, wait for dear life.

detail.summary: Suryakumar Yadav takes a superb diving catch running to his right to end the game.
detail.quote: Superbly held there.

detail.summary: Batter pulls a match-winning boundary to win the game for Eagle Thane Strikers.
detail.quote: He smacks it, pulls it into...
